name: Clear Water - See Through Water
summary: Makes water translucent so you can see the seabed, ores and mobs while swimming.
body:
**Clear Water - See Through Water** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- Water is rendered translucent instead of opaque
- The full-screen blue overlay you get with your head underwater is removed
- The water surface overlay is cleared as well, so the view stays clean from above too

### Why players use it
- You can spot mineshafts, shipwrecks, mobs and ore while swimming
- Handy for ocean monuments, drowned farming and underwater building

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)
